<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation
When prefill and decode run different attention TP sizes, `MoriKVManager.send_kvcache` always builds a per-token head-slice plan (`_build_tp_slice_transfer_plan`): one RDMA write of `heads_bytes_per_token_to_send` per token, per layer, for K and V, and the same offset lists are converted from Python lists for every layer's `batch_write`. 

With few KV heads, that "slice" is often the whole token row on both sides. Qwen3.5 has 2 KV heads, so with prefill attention TP2 and decode TP4 every prefill rank holds one head and every decode rank holds one replicated head: `compute_head_slice_params` returns zero head offsets on both sides and a slice size equal to the token row, and the source and destination pages share one layout. The slicing buys nothing yet: 
- a 108k-token request sends ~3.2M 256-byte writes to each decode rank (page-wise it is ~200k 4 KiB writes before coalescing);
- building those plans holds the GIL on the prefill scheduler process, so prefill batches slow down as more transfers are in flight;
- across nodes the KV arrives late, requests pile up on the decode side waiting for KV, and TTFT reaches 20-30 s at modest concurrency. 

This makes the "small prefill TP + larger decode TP" layout, which suits models with few KV heads.
<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
## Modifications
`python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/mori/conn.py`: 
- `_tp_slice_is_full_row(tp_cfg)`: the TP-mismatch slice is the whole token row when the source and destination item lengths match, both head offsets are zero and the slice size equals the source token row. That holds exactly when every rank on both sides keeps whole, replicated KV heads, e.g. 2 KV heads with P2->D4, P2->D8, P4->D8, P4->D2 or P8->D2.  
- `send_kvcache`: in that case drop the slice config and send through the existing contiguous page plan, which also coalesces adjacent pages. Real head splits (for example P1->D2, where a decode rank needs part of a prefill rank's heads) keep the per-token plan unchanged. 

Only the prefill sender changes. There is no new buffer, kernel, flag, registration field or protocol change, and the decode side is untouched, so mixed old/new peers keep working. MLA, DCP relayout and state transfers (`_send_mamba_state`, SWA) are not affected.  

`test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mori_tp_slice_full_row.py` (CPU, MoRI stubbed like `test_mori_deferred_kv_release.py`): 
- the full-row verdict for every (prefill rank, decode rank) pair: true for replicated heads (2 KV heads with P2->D4, P2->D8, P4->D8, P4->D2, P8->D2), false for real splits (2 KV heads with P1->D2, P1->D4, P2->D1; 8 KV heads with P2->D4, P4->D2), and never dependent on the rank pair;
- for a full-row config, the per-token slice plan and the contiguous page plan cover exactly the same byte ranges, over a mix of contiguous runs and scattered pages, with one entry per page run instead of one per token;
- `send_kvcache` submits one page-plan write per layer and K/V for replicated heads, and keeps 256-byte token slices for split heads.

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->


## Accuracy Tests
GSM8K (chat, thinking off, 5-shot, real MTP acceptance), Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MXFP4, P TP2 -> D TP4 over MoRI:

| | GSM8K |
|---|---|
| this PR(P TP2 -> D TP4) | 0.974 (1319 questions) |
| aggregated, no PD | 0.975 |
| PD with matched TP (P TP2 -> D TP2) | 0.974 |
<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

## Speed Tests and Profiling
MI355X (Vultr), `amd/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MXFP4-AttnFP8-V2`, EAGLE MTP (3 steps, 4 draft tokens), fp8_e4m3 KV, page 16, HiCache on prefill. One prefill worker (attention TP2) and one decode worker (attention TP4) on different nodes, MoRI over RDMA. AgentX multi-turn coding trace, closed loop, concurrency 40, 60 minutes. Same image (`lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261028`), server args and environment; the only difference is this patch.

| | without this PR | this PR | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| prefill time per full 16k chunk, by in-flight transfers 0-3 / 4-7 / 8-11 / 12-15 | 1.65 / 2.48 / 2.96 / 2.83 s | 0.51 / 0.46 / 0.66 / 0.56 s | back to the TP-matched ~0.5 s, flat in in-flight transfers |
| requests waiting for KV on decode (mean) | 21.0 | 1.4 | |
| requests running on decode (mean) | 3.6 | 6.4 | |
| TTFT p50 / p90 | 19.8 / 29.6 s | 1.01 / 2.40 s | -95% / -92% |
| output throughput per GPU | 195 tok/s | 316 tok/s | +62% |
| requests completed in 60 min | 4333 | 6960 | +61% |
| TPOT p50 | 2.45 ms | 3.92 ms | larger decode batches |

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

detail.title: [Perf] [AMD] mori Qwen3.5: Send replicated KV heads as pages across P/D attention TP mismatch

files.patch:
@@ -1396,6 +1396,22 @@ def _build_tp_slice_transfer_plan(
             sizes=sizes,
         )
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tp_slice_is_full_row(tp_cfg: TPSliceConfig) -> bool:
+        """Whether the TP-mismatch head slice is the whole token row on both sides.
+
+        That holds when every rank stores whole, replicated KV heads, e.g. 2 KV heads
+        with prefill attention TP2 and decode TP4 or TP8: each rank keeps one head,
+        so source and destination pages share one layout and need no per-token
+        slicing.
+        """
+        return (
+            tp_cfg.src_item_len == tp_cfg.dst_item_len
+            and tp_cfg.src_head_slice_offset == 0
+            and tp_cfg.dst_head_slice_offset == 0
+            and tp_cfg.heads_bytes_per_token_to_send == tp_cfg.bytes_per_token_src
+        )
+
     def send_kvcache(
         self,
         peer_info: KVArgsRegisterInfo,
@@ -1440,8 +1456,14 @@ def send_kvcache(
             peer_info.dst_kv_mem_descs, peer_info.dst_kv_layer_ids
         )
 
+        tp_cfg = None
         if peer_info.decode_tp_size != self.attn_tp_size:
             tp_cfg = self._build_tp_slice_config(peer_info)
+            if self._tp_slice_is_full_row(tp_cfg):
+                # Replicated KV heads: the decode rank wants this rank's whole token
+                # row, so the pages move as-is through the contiguous plan below.
+                tp_cfg = None
+        if tp_cfg is not None:
             slice_plan = self._build_tp_slice_transfer_plan(
                 prefill_kv_indices, dst_kv_indices, tp_cfg
             )

@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+"""Mori KV transfer between prefill and decode with different attention TP sizes.
+
+When every rank stores whole, replicated KV heads (fewer KV heads than the larger
+attention TP), the TP-mismatch head slice is the whole token row and the transfer
+must use the contiguous page plan rather than one RDMA write per token.
+"""
+
+import importlib
+import sys
+import types
+import unittest
+from enum import IntEnum
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import numpy as np
+
+
+def _install_mori_stubs() -> None:
+    try:
+        importlib.import_module("mori.cpp")
+        importlib.import_module("mori.io")
+        return
+    except (ImportError, OSError):
+        pass
+
+    mori = types.ModuleType("mori")
+    mori.__path__ = []
+    mori_cpp = types.ModuleType("mori.cpp")
+    mori_io = types.ModuleType("mori.io")
+
+    class FakeStatusCode(IntEnum):
+        SUCCESS = 0
+        IN_PROGRESS = 1
+        FAILED = 2
+
+    mori_cpp.TransferStatus = object
+    for name in (
+        "BackendType",
+        "EngineDesc",
+        "IOEngine",
+        "IOEngineConfig",
+        "MemoryDesc",
+        "MemoryLocationType",
+        "PollCqMode",
+        "RdmaBackendConfig",
+    ):
+        setattr(mori_io, name, object)
+    mori_io.StatusCode = FakeStatusCode
+    mori.cpp = mori_cpp
+    mori.io = mori_io
+    sys.modules["mori"] = mori
+    sys.modules["mori.cpp"] = mori_cpp
+    sys.modules["mori.io"] = mori_io
+
+
+_install_mori_stubs()
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mori.conn import (
+    BatchTransferPlan,
+    GroupedIndexPlan,
+    MoriKVManager,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 16
+HEAD_BYTES = 256  # head_dim 256, fp8
+
+
+def _manager(prefill_tp: int, prefill_rank: int, total_kv_heads: int) -> MoriKVManager:
+    heads = max(1, total_kv_heads // prefill_tp)
+    manager = object.__new__(MoriKVManager)
+    manager.attn_tp_size = prefill_tp
+    manager.is_mla_backend = False
+    manager.is_hybrid_mla_backend = False
+    manager.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(
+        page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
+        kv_item_lens=[PAGE_SIZE * heads * HEAD_BYTES],
+        total_kv_head_num=total_kv_heads,
+        kv_head_num=heads,
+        engine_rank=prefill_rank,
+    )
+    return manager
+
+
+def _peer(decode_tp: int, decode_rank: int, total_kv_heads: int):
+    heads = max(1, total_kv_heads // decode_tp)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        decode_tp_size=decode_tp,
+        decode_tp_rank=decode_rank,
+        dst_kv_item_len=PAGE_SIZE * heads * HEAD_BYTES,
+        dst_kv_mem_descs=[],
+        dst_kv_layer_ids=[],
+    )
+
+
+def _byte_ranges(plan: BatchTransferPlan):
+    """Merged (local_start, remote_start, length) runs covered by a plan."""
+    runs = sorted(zip(plan.local_offsets, plan.remote_offsets, plan.sizes))
+    merged = []
+    for local, remote, size in runs:
+        if merged:
+            l0, r0, s0 = merged[-1]
+            if l0 + s0 == local and r0 + s0 == remote:
+                merged[-1] = (l0, r0, s0 + size)
+                continue
+        merged.append((local, remote, size))
+    return merged
+
+
+class TestTPSliceFullRow(CustomTestCase):
+    def _is_full_row(self, prefill_tp, decode_tp, total_kv_heads):
+        """Full-row verdicts for every (prefill rank, decode rank) pair."""
+        verdicts = set()
+        for p_rank in range(prefill_tp):
+            for d_rank in range(decode_tp):
+                manager = _manager(prefill_tp, p_rank, total_kv_heads)
+                cfg = manager._build_tp_slice_config(
+                    _peer(decode_tp, d_rank, total_kv_heads)
+                )
+                verdicts.add(MoriKVManager._tp_slice_is_full_row(cfg))
+        self.assertEqual(len(verdicts), 1, "verdict must not depend on the rank pair")
+        return verdicts.pop()
+
+    def test_replicated_heads_are_full_rows(self):
+        # 2 KV heads (e.g. Qwen3.5-397B): one whole head per rank on both sides.
+        for prefill_tp, decode_tp in ((2, 4), (2, 8), (4, 8), (4, 2), (8, 2)):
+            with self.subTest(prefill_tp=prefill_tp, decode_tp=decode_tp):
+                self.assertTrue(self._is_full_row(prefill_tp, decode_tp, 2))
+
+    def test_split_heads_still_slice(self):
+        # A side holding several heads must still send per-head slices.
+        for prefill_tp, decode_tp, heads in (
+            (1, 2, 2),
+            (1, 4, 2),
+            (2, 1, 2),
+            (2, 4, 8),
+            (4, 2, 8),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(prefill_tp=prefill_tp, decode_tp=decode_tp, heads=heads):
+                self.assertFalse(self._is_full_row(prefill_tp, decode_tp, heads))
+
+    def test_full_row_slice_plan_matches_contiguous_plan(self):
+        rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
+        manager = _manager(2, 1, 2)
+        cfg = manager._build_tp_slice_config(_peer(4, 3, 2))
+        self.assertTrue(MoriKVManager._tp_slice_is_full_row(cfg))
+        # Mix contiguous runs and scattered pages, as the allocator produces them.
+        src = np.concatenate(
+            [np.arange(100, 140), rng.choice(5000, 30, replace=False) + 200]
+        )
+        dst = np.concatenate(
+            [np.arange(900, 940), rng.choice(5000, 30, replace=False) + 6000]
+        )
+        src, dst = src.astype(np.int32), dst.astype(np.int32)
+
+        slice_plan = manager._build_tp_slice_transfer_plan(src, dst, cfg)
+        grouped = GroupedIndexPlan.from_indices(
+            src.astype(np.int64), dst.astype(np.int64)
+        )
+        page_plan = grouped.materialize(manager.kv_args.kv_item_lens[0])
+
+        self.assertEqual(_byte_ranges(slice_plan), _byte_ranges(page_plan))
+        self.assertEqual(len(slice_plan.sizes), len(src) * PAGE_SIZE)
+        self.assertLess(len(page_plan.sizes), len(src))
+
+    def _submitted_plans(self, manager, peer, src, dst):
+        plans = []
+        num_layers = 3
+        manager._get_mha_mem_desc_slices = lambda descs, layer_ids: (
+            [f"k{i}" for i in range(num_layers)],
+            [f"v{i}" for i in range(num_layers)],
+            [f"dk{i}" for i in range(num_layers)],
+            [f"dv{i}" for i in range(num_layers)],
+            num_layers,
+        )
+        manager._submit_batch_transfer_plan = lambda s, d, plan: (
+            plans.append(plan) or []
+        )
+        manager.send_kvcache(peer, src, dst)
+        self.assertEqual(len(plans), 2 * num_layers)
+        return plans
+
+    def test_send_kvcache_uses_page_plan_for_replicated_heads(self):
+        src = np.arange(10, 74, dtype=np.int32)
+        dst = np.arange(500, 564, dtype=np.int32)
+        plans = self._submitted_plans(_manager(2, 0, 2), _peer(4, 1, 2), src, dst)
+        for plan in plans:
+            self.assertEqual(plan.sizes, [len(src) * PAGE_SIZE * HEAD_BYTES])
+
+    def test_send_kvcache_keeps_token_slices_for_split_heads(self):
+        src = np.arange(10, 74, dtype=np.int32)
+        dst = np.arange(500, 564, dtype=np.int32)
+        plans = self._submitted_plans(_manager(1, 0, 2), _peer(2, 1, 2), src, dst)
+        for plan in plans:
+            self.assertEqual(len(plan.sizes), len(src) * PAGE_SIZE)
+            self.assertEqual(set(plan.sizes), {HEAD_BYTES})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
